resources.string: Tandem had to reset its storage
The key that protects your login could not be used, for example after the app was restored to a new phone. Saved logins were removed.
Saved logins could not be read and were removed.
Settings could not be read and were reset.
Secure storage on this device is not available right now, so logins cannot be saved. Restart the phone; if that does not help, clear the app data.
Only data on this device was affected. Everything in your Tandoor is unchanged.
All logins and settings are removed from this device. Nothing is deleted on your Tandoor server.
Some data could not be cleared. The encryption keys were destroyed, so it can no longer be read.
